p: Crewe is a railway town through and through, and Nantwich Road is the busy artery between the station and the rest of town, lined with takeaways, convenience stores and independent shops.

It's also football country. Crewe Alexandra's Gresty Road ground is just off Nantwich Road, so expect it to get lively when the Alex are at home. If you've got time to kill between trains, this stretch has plenty of places for a quick bite. Admiral is an adult gaming centre, which means 18+ only. Railway buffs might want to look up Crewe Heritage Centre, close to the line, while Nantwich, with its black-and-white timbered buildings, is only a few miles down the road.
